plain_english_policy: This bill directs Cherokee County to split incoming tax distribution funds from the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) into three specific shares: 45% goes to the Industrial Development Board, 30% to the Chamber of Commerce, and 25% to the Public Parks and Recreation Board. The policy effect is purely administrative allocation; it does not create new taxes or spending authority but rather defines how existing TVA payments are divided among local entities.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would legally mandate that Cherokee County distribute its share of TVA tax-in-lieu-of-taxes funds according to the specified percentages, ensuring those specific boards receive their designated portions immediately upon receipt of state-authorized distributions under Act 2010-135.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey (N & P) sponsored the bill to establish this distribution framework for Cherokee County's TVA funds.
evidence_quotes: Forty-five percent of the funds shall be distributed to the Cherokee County Industrial Development Board, 30 percent shall be distributed to the Cherokee County Chamber of Commerce, and 25 percent shall be distributed to the Public Parks and Recreation Board of Cherokee County, Alabama, Inc.
Relating to Cherokee County; to provide for the distribution of the county's share of any tax distributions received pursuant to Act 2010-135
